## What a user saw (#1843)

The Budget tab showed two unrelated money panels, one above the other: *Trip cost* (four items) and *Budget vs actual* (nine categories, `$0.00` everywhere, **"Remaining -$0.00"**, and copy written for developers). The price list was set in Title Case ("No Source Has Priced This Yet."). Four buttons were all named "Save". "Other costs" could only reach fully priced if you knew to type 0.

## Change

- The tracker sits behind `<details>` titled **"Track your own budget and actual spend (optional)"**. It is open only when a budget or spend already exists. Its intro now says what it is for, and that the packet itemises the prices above.
- `formatCurrency` rounds and folds negative zero. With no budget set: "No budget set" / "Nothing recorded" in place of `$0.00`.
- `.focus-area-list li { text-transform: capitalize }` is replaced by `::first-letter { text-transform: uppercase }`: key-built chips stay tidy, and sentences are no longer Title Cased (this also fixes "Transfer(S)" in Compare). The price list drops that class.
- `aria-label` "Save / Update / Remove <item>" on each button.
- Other costs hint: "Enter 0 if there are none, so the trip counts as fully priced."

## Gates

| gate | break | result |
|---|---|---|
| `TripPricesPanel.test.tsx`: four distinct accessible names; no bare "Save"; Other-costs hint | drop the aria-labels | 4 fail |
| `WorkspaceBudgetPanel.test.tsx`: no `-$0` for an unset (`-0`) or drained (`-0.001`) budget | format the unrounded amount | 1 fail |
| `WorkspacePage.test.tsx`: tracker disclosure present in the real Budget tab, closed with no budget | — | pass |

Local: frontend tsc clean, 201/201. No backend change.

Fixes #1843

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Added a collapsible budget tracker below trip prices.
  - The tracker opens automatically when a budget or spending activity exists.
  - Added clearer guidance for recording “Other costs,” including entering $0 when none apply.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved currency rounding and prevented negative-zero amounts.
  - Added clearer empty-state messages for missing budgets and spending records.
  - Improved button labels for saving, updating, and removing price items.

- **Style**
  - Preserved sentence casing in focus-area labels.
  - Updated budget tracker disclosure styling.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
title: Budget tab: one trip total, no negative zero, no Title Case, named buttons
